ablation.name: t11e1_ll05_15ep
ablation.notes: T11 evo-1: Micro LL style injection (endpoint_adain_scale_ll 0.0->0.05). T11's core contradiction: CLIP-S needs low-freq style, but LL bypass (scale=0.0) blocks it. T12 inference sweep proved 0.1 is too much (1:8 trade-off). 0.05 is HALF of 0.1, tests if micro LL WCT can lift clip without destroying lpips. Training-time change (not inference override), so model learns to compensate.
